title: Li enseignement de / De touz les / Ecce tu (anonymous, Ivrea Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Li enseignement de / De touz les / Ecce tu. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot.
